crossRefs.note: For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.
Blessed be Yahweh, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify Yahweh’s…
I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem.…
Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no…
Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all…
the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre, skillful to work in gold, in silver, in…
Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge;
But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

people.name: Ahisamach
people.line: Father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan for the tabernacle

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

translations.web: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
translations.bsb: And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.
translations.kjv: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
translations.asv: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
